name: un-locode
title: UN-LOCODE Codelist
description: UN/LOCODE is a geographic coding scheme developed and maintained by the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE). It provides codes for locations used in international trade and transport, covering ports, airports, rail terminals, road terminals, and other transport-related locations worldwide.

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0

resources.name: code-list
resources.description: Main UN/LOCODE codelist. Each row is a location entry identified by a 2-letter country code and a 3-character location code. Rows with an empty Location field are country-name header rows or alias rows and are excluded from this file.

fields.name: Change
fields.description: + (newly added); X (to be removed); | (changed); # (name changed); = (reference entry); ! (US location with duplicate IATA code)

fields.name: Country
fields.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code. Defined in country-codes.csv.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: 3-character location code (letters and digits 2–9). Combined with Country it forms the full 5-character UN/LOCODE.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Official name of the location, may include diacritics.

fields.name: NameWoDiacritics
fields.description: Name of the location with diacritics replaced by their ASCII equivalents.

fields.name: Subdivision
fields.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for the location. Defined in subdivision-codes.csv. May be empty.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Approval/verification status of the entry. Defined in status-indicators.csv.

fields.name: Function
fields.description: 8-character function classifier string indicating which transport functions the location serves. Each position corresponds to a function code defined in function-classifiers.csv; a digit means the function is present, a dash means absent.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: Edition date in YYMM format (2-digit year + 2-digit month, e.g. 0601 = June 2006, 1407 = July 2014). May be empty for some entries.

fields.name: IATA
fields.description: IATA airport code, present only when it differs from the UN/LOCODE location code. May be empty.

fields.name: Coordinates
fields.description: Geographic coordinates in DDMM[N/S] DDDMM[W/E] format (degrees and minutes). May be empty.

fields.name: Remarks
fields.description: Free-text remarks or notes about the location entry. May be empty.

resources.name: country-codes
resources.description: Lookup table mapping ISO 3166 alpha-2 country codes to country names, as used in the UN/LOCODE codelist.

fields.name: CountryCode
fields.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (2 uppercase letters).

fields.name: CountryName
fields.description: Official English name of the country.

resources.name: function-classifiers
resources.description: Lookup table defining the meaning of each position in the Function field of the code-list. Each code corresponds to a transport or logistics function.

fields.name: FunctionCode
fields.description: Single-character function code (0–8 or B) used in the Function field of code-list.csv.

fields.name: FunctionDescription
fields.description: Human-readable description of the transport or logistics function.

resources.name: status-indicators
resources.description: Lookup table defining the meaning of the Status field in the code-list. Status codes indicate the approval or verification level of each location entry.

fields.name: STStatus
fields.description: 2-letter status code used in the Status field of code-list.csv.

fields.name: STDescription
fields.description: Human-readable description of the approval or verification status.

resources.name: subdivision-codes
resources.description: Lookup table of ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (states, provinces, regions, etc.) referenced by the Subdivision field of the code-list.

fields.name: SUCountry
fields.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code for the subdivision.

fields.name: SUCode
fields.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (without the country prefix).

fields.name: SUName
fields.description: Name of the subdivision (state, province, region, etc.).

fields.name: SUType
fields.description: Type of the administrative subdivision (e.g. Province, State, Region, Emirate). May be empty for some entries.

resources.name: alias
resources.description: Alternative names (aliases) for countries, extracted from UN/LOCODE source files. These are rows in the source data with Change code '=' and no location code.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code the alias applies to.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Alternative country or region name, may include diacritics.

fields.name: NameWoDiacritics
fields.description: Alternative name with diacritics replaced by ASCII equivalents.
